latest.title: Amplify SSR gotcha: chasing a bug that was never in my code
latest.description: I deployed a Next.js app to Amplify Hosting with Bedrock and lost a night to six things the docs do not cover: an SDK client that disabled its own credential chain, environment variables that never reach the SSR Lambda, missing Marketplace permissions, and a hard 28 second gateway timeout that appears in no AWS documentation page. Includes the overnight commit log, the CloudWatch evidence, and the model swap that finally got the response under the wall.

latest.title: A write-up about Lambda durable functions got the docs fixed
latest.description: I tested Lambda durable functions by building a human-in-the-loop AI agent pipeline and wrote up two sharp edges: an undocumented IAM pattern for callbacks and stale SDK examples. Eight days later the examples were removed and the developer guide gained a callback permissions page. Here's the timeline.

trending.title: Get Started with GPT-5.6 on Amazon Bedrock in 15 Minutes
trending.description: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 (Sol / Terra / Luna) is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock. This walkthrough takes you from zero to running in six steps: set up, first call, compare all three tiers, sweep all six reasoning effort levels, cut the cost of repeated input to a tenth with prompt caching, and finally let the model call a real MCP tool. It all runs through your own AWS account with no OpenAI API key. Every command is copy-pasteable and every number is measured, not estimated.

trending.title: Understanding Amazon Web Services (AWS)
trending.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a cloud computing platform developed by Amazon that provides a wide range of on-demand services, including computing power, storage, databases, networking, and security. It enables individuals and organisations to build, manage, and scale applications without investing in expensive physical infrastructure. AWS is widely used because it is reliable, secure, flexible, and cost-effective, making it one of the most popular cloud platforms in the world.
